A bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species'''<ref name="TROS VD" /> had large, angular skulls; wide-set, [[Reptile|reptilian]] [[eye]]s; and a long, low-slung, flat-nosed snout. They could have [[Color|gray]]<ref name="SOTS" /> or brown skin, black [[hair]], and black eyes. The [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] [[Dered Karno]] and [[Ommo Twilto]] belonged to the [[species]],<ref name="TROS VD" /> as did the identical [[twin]]s [[Bosvarga]] and [[Cerensco]].<ref name="SOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
